overview: AI Doubt Solver is a full-stack AI-powered tutoring app for students. Ask questions by typing, uploading a photo of a problem, or recording your voice — and get instant step-by-step explanations. Every conversation is saved and organized by subject so you can revisit past doubts anytime.
features: Internet Identity login with persistent session
Text, image, and voice doubt input modes
AI-powered step-by-step explanations via Groq LLaMA
Image analysis for textbook diagrams and equations
Auto-detection of subject (Math, Physics, Chemistry, etc.)
Markdown rendering with headings, lists, and code blocks
Chat history grouped by subject with search and filter
Responsive layout with collapsible sidebar on mobile
